sentences.text: In 1843, Ada Lovelace published notes on Babbage's proposed Analytical Engine.

sentences.text: Her Note G laid out steps for calculating Bernoulli numbers, often called the first published computer algorithm.

sentences.text: The engine was never completed in her lifetime.
